89551245.title: File:Coffee in cup amenable to easy cup colour changes such that it still looks like an unaltered coffee-in-cup photo.xcf

ObjectName.value: Coffee in cup amenable to easy cup colour changes such that it still looks like an unaltered coffee-in-cup photo

Categories.value: CC-Zero|Illustrations|Self-published work|PNG created with GIMP|XCF files|Coffee icons

ImageDescription.value:
I developed this work, in order to have a coffee-in-cup graphic for different sections of a contract. The idea was to colour the cup differently depending on the section of the contract in which it was used. Such use is good for decoration, aesthetics, and real functional value (colours and coffee-in-cup symbol hopefully facilitate easier contract reading).
The coffee and coffee stains around the lip are in a separate layer. The cup is in another layer and a gradient tint over the coffee is in yet another layer. You can colourise these latter two layers, and it will still look like a genuine photo of coffee in a cup but just with a different coloured cup.

UsageTerms.value: Creative Commons Zero, Public Domain Dedication
